text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after school. I was bowing my head
to Dream Journey with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering where it went, but I see.
My documents got mixed in with your materials...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came here before to borrow expedition materials.
I must have taken it by mistake back then.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Please, don't worry about it. ...I'm also at fault for leaving the papers where they could get mixed up.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I couldn't get my hands on what I came for that day.
My mind has been wandering ever since――

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ! Excuse me, that book tucked under your arm...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Unless my memory fails me... isn't this the travelogue anthology of France
that had a limited release just a few days ago?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. I'm surprised you know about it, considering how obscure it is.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that happens to be the very item I was searching for earlier.
...To think I would find it in a place like this.
choice_data_list: ...! In that case, I'll give you this book.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly presented the book to her wide-eyed self.
I had brought it to leave in the trainer's office, but there could be no better apology than this.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Goodness... Are you sure?
This is such an extremely rare book, yet――
choice_data_list: If you care about me, please accept it.
If you care about me, please take it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I, see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No... I was just thinking
what a truly kind person you are.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Splendid. You truly appear to be someone overflowing with radiant virtue.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, please do take care.
For light, at times—calls forth the darkness.
choice_data_list: I've got an average amount of strength, so I'll be fine.
I make sure to pick who I ask, you know.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... But wouldn't that make it impossible to compete against an Umamusume?
choice_data_list: Everyone here is as sweet as you.
There are only kind girls like you around here.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so?
...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Now then. Are these all
the materials you requested?
choice_data_list: Yeah. There's no mistake this time.
うん。今度こそ間違いないよ

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
My apologies, that was unnecessary advice.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I happen to be quite the worrier, you see.
Please forgive my overreaction.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Now then. Are these all
the materials you requested?
choice_data_list: Yeah. There's no mistake this time.
うん。今度こそ間違いないよ

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...There aren't any mixed-up documents, correct?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I kid.
—I look forward to your next visit.
